Scenario: Owned course selector and empty exam builder
Expected: Owned drafts/published courses appear; foreign courses and global permission do not.
Actual: Owned draft/published options and blank question verified; foreign course absent and global option disabled.

Expected: Request stays pending until the superadmin approves it.
Actual: Teacher request persisted PENDING; superadmin UI approval unlocked the global exam option.

Expected: Education, department and selected-student filters persist.
Actual: Selenium created a global exam; MongoDB persisted SCHOOL + normalized science + the selected student ID.

Scenario: Targeted exam discovery and direct access
Expected: Only an eligible student can discover and open the exam.
Actual: Selected School learner saw the banner and exam. College learner saw neither listing nor private detail through the copied URL.

Expected: Exam approval does not grant contest hosting.
Actual: Contest global option remained locked after exam approval, then unlocked after a separate request and superadmin approval.

Expected: University CSE sees the contest; EEE cannot open it.
Actual: Teacher published a real targeted contest; University CSE listing/detail succeeded and EEE listing/direct access were denied.

Expected: Assigned instructor can select the course without changing its owner.
Actual: Superadmin UI assignment added the existing course to the teacher’s assessment selector; MongoDB owner was unchanged.

Expected: A saved department change removes stale exam eligibility.
Actual: Selenium changed Science to Humanities, verified persistence and immediate direct-link exclusion, then restored Science.

Scenario: Create a course with no profile image
Expected: Image-less approved instructor can create and reopen curriculum.
Actual: Real course form created the course, module and lesson without a profile image; ownership and reopened curriculum passed.

Expected: Anonymous users cannot open an unpublished course.
Actual: Direct URL to a draft course displayed the not-found page in signed-out Chrome.

Expected: Enrollment persists as one record after revisits.
Actual: Real free enrollment opened the course; reload retained access and exactly one enrollment record.

Expected: Completing one of two lessons persists 50% progress.
Actual: Completion button wrote one actual lesson-progress record; after reload one of two lessons displayed 50%.

Expected: Submitting a request does not unlock expired access.
Actual: Student modal submitted a real revision request; MongoDB remained PENDING with isRevisionGranted=false.

Expected: An unrelated instructor cannot see another owner’s revision request.
Actual: Unrelated instructor queue omitted the private revision request and showed its empty state.

Expected: Owner review grants the configured period and restores access.
Actual: Course owner approved through Selenium; reviewer and seven-day grant were saved and the student saw active revision access.

Scenario: Keyboard MCQ selection and modal return
Expected: Tab, Space and Enter select answers; modal Back preserves selection.
Actual: Selenium keyboard input reached options, changed selection with Space/Enter and preserved the final answer after returning from review.

Expected: Correct/wrong/skipped score is 1.75/6; retry is on cooldown, below the cap.
Actual: Real UI submission persisted 1.75/6, 29%, failed: one correct, one wrong and one skipped. Reload retained one submission and did not show the false attempt-limit warning at one of two attempts.

Scenario: Empty dashboard has no invented progress
Expected: Unenrolled learner sees no 67% or 30/45-minute progress.
Actual: Dashboard for a learner with zero enrollments showed no fabricated 67% or 30/45-minute progress.

Scenario: Actual PDF viewer and resource visibility
Expected: Enrolled learner opens a real PDF; anonymous view exposes only preview resource.
Actual: The enrolled PDF modal and iframe opened. Direct HTTP returned 200 with valid PDF bytes, but Chrome fetch returned HTTP 204 and an empty body. The case failed before all anonymous-resource checks completed. Cause unconfirmed; PDF viewer/delivery reliability remains open.

Expected: No horizontal overflow at 360px and desktop widths.
Actual: Login, course detail, exam form and contest form had no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px window sizes.

Expected: Language persists after reload while saved values stay unchanged.
Actual: Selenium switched to Bangla, reloaded successfully, switched back to English and verified the saved Science department.

Scenario: Missing course, exam and contest links
Expected: Missing identifiers fail gracefully without unrelated content.
Actual: Selenium verified safe not-found states for nonexistent course, exam and contest links.

Expected: After UI signout, protected revisits redirect to login.
Actual: Navbar signout removed the session; revisiting the student dashboard redirected to login.

Scenario: Read navigation does not reseed content
Expected: Repeated visits leave content counts unchanged.
Actual: Selenium navigation/reloads left user, course, exam, contest and notification counts unchanged; no sample reseeding.
